newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pacific Investment increases loan facility.
newsitem.headline: First Pacific Investment increases loan facility.

text.p: First Pacific Investments' term loan facility has been increased to US$245 million from US$150 million due to oversubscription, coordinating arranger Union Bank of Switzerland said on Thursday.
The three-year facility pays an interest margin of 175 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
The loan is secured on shares of First Pacific Co.
First Pacific Investments and Salim Group hold 38.6 percent and 15.28 percent interest in the borrower, respectively.
Proceeds are to be used for a number of projects in Indonesia associated with the Salim Group.
Coordinating arranger Union Bank of Switzerland committed US$21 million.
Arrangers with US$10 million each are Boram Bank, DBS Bank, DCB Bank Labuan, Korea Long Term Credit Bank and Malayan Banking Berhad.
Co-arranger Standard Chartered Bank committed US$20 million.
Other co-arrangers with US$10 million each are Daehan Investment Banking Corp, OCBC, Banco Santander SA, and Union Europeenne de CIC.
Lead managers with US$7.5 million each are KEXIM International Singapore and Wing Hang Bank.

Managers with US$5 million each are Bank Austria, Bangkok Bank, Daegu Bank, Dah Sing Bank, DongNam Bank, E.Sun Commercial Bank, First Commercial Bank, First Merchant Banking Corp, Korea Merchant Banking Corp, Korean French Banking Corp, Pacific Bank Berhad, and Tat Lee Bank
Co-manager Credito Italiano SpA committed US$4 million.

Other co-managers with US$3 million each are Chung Chong Bank, Daedong Bank, Far Eastern International Bank, Hyundai Finance Asia, KEB Leasing and Finance, Korea Leasing Singapore, and Taishin International Bank.

Other co-managers with US$2 million each are Baden-Wurtembergische Bank AG, Bank of Ayudhya, Bumi Daya International Finance, KDLC Leasing Singapore, KEXIM Asia, Siam Commercial Bank, and Ta Chong Bank. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2847 4039
